'''February 2001 Sioux Falls tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Dragon's Den, Sioux Falls, SD on 25 February 2001. [[Adam Nemmers]] won it. It is known from Tyler Williams's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1805">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-sioux-falls-sd-2-25-00-snow-sucksd1805/ sioux-falls-sd-2-25-00-snow-sucks], DeckTech (Tyler "rugman11" Williams, 26 February 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-02-26-sioux-falls-sd-2-25-00-snow-sucksd1805/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 25 February 2001
* '''Site:''' Dragon's Den, Sioux Falls, SD
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections II]]
* '''Players:''' 8
* '''Winner:''' [[Adam Nemmers]]
